newsitem.title: UK: Charles and Diana to stay on kissing gate.
newsitem.headline: Charles and Diana to stay on kissing gate.

text.p: Prince Charles and Princess Diana may have split in an acrimonious divorce but the ill-starred royal couple's marriage is still to be commemorated in the English village of Lower Slaughter.
Villagers were split over whether to remove a plaque on a local kissing gate that commemorated the wedding 15 years ago.

But parish councillors decided on Monday night to keep the plaque. "We felt it should stay exactly as it is -- although we are a bit concerned someone might now try to pinch it," said chairwoman Gillie Lord.
"There are already signs today that someone has put a screwdriver behind it and tried to wrench it off," she said.

The plaque, stating that Charles married Lady Diana Spencer in July 1981, was erected because the so-called kissing gate -- a u-shaped structure designed to let one person through at a time -- was installed to replace an awkward stile that year.
